metadata.case_name: FUNG YUET HING v. MOK SUN AND ANOTHER

injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

injuries.description: (i) Mild whiplash injury to the neck; soft tissue sprain in the neck;
source: (i) Mild whiplash injury to the neck; soft tissue sprain in the neck;
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain, stiffness or tenderness only

injuries.description: (iii) Possible contusion of the anterior left shin.
source: (iii) Possible contusion of the anterior left shin.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified parts of lower leg

manifestations.description: Persistent pain at neck which is aggravated during prolonged sitting and change of weather
Feeling tired easily at her neck
the range of motion of her neck is reduced
Swelling and pain at her lower back after prolonged sitting
2 scars are visible namely near her left eye of length of 1 cm.
Insomnia and memory is badly affected
Feeling nervous when taking buses again, particularly New Lantau Buses
Feeling tenderness at her left lower leg
Unable to sit, stand or walk for prolonged period of time
Sleeping has been affected and sleeping posture is restricted
tenderness over forehead, face, left neck and occiput (A&E examination)
abrasion over left forehead, left face (A&E examination)

treatments_received: Accident & Emergency treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital (A&E) including examination and wound care
Two stitches on the left eyebrow
Physiotherapy (8 times in January and 2 times in February, last treatment on 12 Feb 2005) - total 10 sessions
Chinese-style manipulative therapy for 3 to 4 months
MRI of the brain and cervical spine at St. Teresa’s Hospital on 10 January 2005 (showed normal findings)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: She no longer participates in Yoga activities, play badminton or squash now due to her injuries.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Feeling nervous when taking buses again, particularly New Lantau Buses.

comparable_cases.case_name: Limbu Ramesh v Chu Fung Man
comparable_cases.injury_description: Plaintiff was struck on his head by an object on the side of the road knocking him unconscious for about 2 hours; intermittent sick leave for 95 days; post-concussional syndrome with some symptoms of headache and dizziness; soft tissue injuries and loss of lordotic curvature of cervical spine.
